card.name: Words before a service or action noun
card.fires_on: Short linking words or verbs such as "taken", "the", "call" and "our" in promotional or instructional text. They come where a noun like service, request, or contact is likely to follow.

modes.description: A word completing a phrase about taking action, such as "taken" after "will be".

card.writes: It pushes down service and request words, so these are less likely to come next.
